Local landscaping

Landscaping in Mount Annan, built for established family blocks

Mount Annan is a settled estate suburb with a real gardening streak, thanks in no small part to the botanic garden on its doorstep. Blocks range from flat to gently sloping, and the local clay means drainage and base prep matter as much as the planting.

We take on the whole yard under one licence, from a garden refresh to a full makeover, quote a fixed price after seeing the site, and never charge a call-out fee.

Get your fixed-price quote

props.label: Section
props.html:
FAQs

Landscaping in Mount Annan: your questions answered

Do you do garden makeovers as well as new builds in Mount Annan?
Yes. A lot of Mount Annan work is reviving established gardens: re-turfing, replanting and refreshing beds and paving, alongside full backyard makeovers when a block needs the lot.
What planting suits a Mount Annan garden?
We choose planting for local conditions, heat, frost and clay, and can take cues from the region's own plant palette. You get a scheme that establishes well and stays manageable.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How soon can you start?
Often quickly, especially for smaller jobs and quotes. We are open 7am to 7pm, 7 days, so call 0451 267 287 and we will tell you honestly what we can do.
